topic.title: Fairness Constraints and Distributional Tradeoffs
topic.overview: This topic develops algorithms that incorporate explicit fairness requirements into prediction, representation learning, matching, and aggregation. Group constraints regulate statistical outcomes, while individual notions depend on meaningful similarities between people. Optimal transport provides one representative tool: it measures how far predictions must move to satisfy fairness constraints while respecting a chosen cost structure.
topic.whyItMatters: Fairness objectives encode substantive choices about whose outcomes should be compared and what changes are acceptable. Mathematical guarantees make those choices testable, but their usefulness depends on whether the constraints and similarity measures fit the application.
topic.evolution: The representatives move from fair representations and sequential decisions to reductions, learned individual metrics, and transport-based regularization. Recent matching methods study exact constraints alongside relaxations, explicitly analyzing fairness–cost tradeoffs and generalization to unseen data.
openQuestions: How should ground costs or similarity metrics be validated with affected stakeholders?
How do fairness guarantees change under distribution shift or noisy group information?

papers.title: Meta Optimality for Demographic Parity Constrained Regression via Post-Processing
papers.tldr: Reusable meta-theorems show how post-processing can achieve minimax-optimal regression under demographic parity.

papers.title: Preserving AUC Fairness in Learning with Noisy Protected Groups
papers.tldr: A distributionally robust optimization approach preserves AUC fairness when protected-group labels are noisy.

papers.title: Settling the Maximin Share Fairness for Scheduling among Groups of Machines
papers.tldr: The paper gives an asymptotically tight factor-2 MMS scheduling guarantee for unrelated machines and a factor of 4/3 for identical machines.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Fair Graph Generation: Theoretical Guarantees and Empirical Advances
papers.tldr: FairGEM jointly addresses bias in graph connections and node features, with theoretical guarantees and empirical improvements in fairness and generation quality.

papers.title: Efficient Fairness-Performance Pareto Front Computation
papers.tldr: A structural reduction makes fairness–performance trade-offs computable through compact optimization problems without training complex fair representation models.

papers.title: Fair Continuous Resource Allocation with Equality of Impact
papers.tldr: Equality of Impact guides online resource allocation toward fair outcomes and high welfare when group responses are unknown and have diminishing marginal effects.

papers.title: Fair Minimum Labeling: Efficient Temporal Network Activations for Reachability and Equity
papers.tldr: Fair Minimum Labeling schedules network connections to meet group coverage requirements at low cost, with approximation guarantees matching the stated hardness bound.

papers.title: Fairness-aware Bayes Optimal Functional Classification
papers.tldr: Fair-FLDA uses group-specific thresholds to control disparity in functional classification, with fairness and risk guarantees under stated structural assumptions.

papers.title: Fairness under Competition
papers.tldr: Individually fair classifiers can produce unfair outcomes across competing firms, and local fairness improvements can sometimes worsen ecosystem fairness.

papers.title: FedFACT: A Provable Framework for Controllable Group-Fairness Calibration in Federated Learning
papers.tldr: FedFACT provides controllable global and local fairness constraints for federated learning, with theory and experiments supporting its accuracy–fairness balance.

papers.title: Improved Algorithms for Fair Matroid Submodular Maximization
papers.tldr: A new approximation algorithm approaches full lower-bound fairness in expectation for monotone submodular selection under matroid constraints.

papers.title: Individual Fairness In Strategic Classification
papers.tldr: The paper derives conditions for individually fair randomized classifiers and uses linear programming to optimize them in strategic classification settings.

papers.title: Kernel-based Equalized Odds: A Quantification of Accuracy-Fairness Trade-off in Fair Representation Learning
papers.tldr: A kernel-based equalized-odds criterion characterizes accuracy–fairness trade-offs and provides an empirical statistic with theoretical error guarantees.

papers.title: Learning with Statistical Equality Constraints
papers.tldr: New generalization theory supports equality-constrained learning through a practical sequence of unconstrained empirical training problems.

papers.title: On Optimal Steering to Achieve Exact Fairness
papers.tldr: The paper finds nearby distributions designed to guarantee exact group fairness and demonstrates steering methods that improve fairness without observed utility loss.

papers.title: Online Multi-Class Selection with Group Fairness Guarantee
papers.tldr: A randomized reservation-and-rounding method preserves group fairness and fractional-solution performance in expectation when allocating resources online.

papers.title: Simple and Effective Specialized Representations for Fair Classifiers
papers.tldr: Characteristic-function-based representation learning improves fairness and accuracy in benchmarks, with a relaxed objective guaranteeing fairness without performance loss for common classifiers.

papers.title: Size-adaptive Hypothesis Testing for Fairness
papers.tldr: A size-adaptive fairness framework combines large-sample hypothesis tests with Bayesian estimation for small intersectional groups.

papers.title: Strategic Costs of Perceived Bias in Fair Selection
papers.tldr: A game-theoretic model shows how group differences in perceived rewards can create disparities even when selection depends solely on merit.

papers.title: The Rashomon Set Has It All: Analyzing Trustworthiness of Trees under Multiplicity
papers.tldr: Enumerated sets of near-optimal sparse trees almost always contain models competitive with specialized trustworthiness methods across the studied metrics.

papers.title: Unifying Proportional Fairness in Centroid and Non-Centroid Clustering
papers.tldr: Semi-centroid clustering unifies two loss definitions and admits a polynomial-time constant-factor approximation to core fairness.

papers.title: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Explaining Metric Compatibility in Fair Machine Learning
papers.tldr: A game-theoretic analysis measures metric compatibility and finds that fairness and utility are often structurally orthogonal rather than directly opposed.

papers.title: A General Framework for Fair and Robust Regression
papers.tldr: A regression framework combines demographic parity with robust losses and provides a controlled tradeoff between fairness and predictive risk.

papers.title: Causal Disentangled Anchor Learning for Scalable Fair Multi-view Clustering
papers.tldr: CDAL separates semantic and sensitive information to improve the fairness–utility trade-off in clustering with linear-time scaling.

papers.title: Demystifying the Optimal Fair Classifier in Multi-Class Classification
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes optimal multiclass accuracy–fairness trade-offs and develops training-time and post-processing algorithms that converge to that frontier.

papers.title: Differentiable Optimization Layers for Guaranteed Fairness in Deep Learning
papers.tldr: A differentiable fairness layer guarantees a chosen output-parity criterion, while an online algorithm provides aggregate fairness for streaming predictions.

papers.title: Fair Classification with Efficient and Post-hoc Controllable Fairness-Accuracy Trade-off
papers.tldr: Learning representations for post-processing lets classifiers adjust their fairness-accuracy balance after training while achieving competitive trade-off efficiency.

papers.title: Fair Decisions from Calibrated Scores: Achieving Optimal Classification While Satisfying Sufficiency
papers.tldr: For finite group-calibrated scores, a geometric post-processing method finds optimal randomized classifiers satisfying sufficiency and can minimize their deviation from separation.

papers.title: Fair Transit Stop Placement: A Clustering Perspective and Beyond
papers.tldr: The paper develops transit-stop algorithms with explicit trade-offs between justified representation and core fairness guarantees.

papers.title: FairGB: A Fair Granular-Ball Generation Method for Data Classification
papers.tldr: FairGB incorporates group balance into granular-ball data partitions and reports an improved accuracy–fairness trade-off in classification.

papers.title: FairRARI: A Plug and Play Framework for Fairness-Aware PageRank
papers.tldr: FairRARI computes PageRank through constrained convex optimization to meet group-fairness targets while preserving favorable computational scaling.

papers.title: FedEBA+: Towards Fair and Effective Federated Learning via Entropy-Based Model
papers.tldr: FedEBA+ combines entropy-derived aggregation weights and client-update alignment to improve fairness while preserving global accuracy.

papers.title: Long-term Fairness with Selective Labels
papers.tldr: A predictor-aware fairness framework supports long-term decision-making when outcomes are only observed after positive decisions.

papers.title: Maximin Relative Improvement: Fair Learning as a Bargaining Problem
papers.tldr: The paper frames group fairness as bargaining and compares groups through the fraction of their achievable risk reduction that a predictor delivers.

papers.title: Online Fair Division with Additional Information
papers.tldr: Future value information enables stronger online fair-division guarantees, with prediction-aware variants that degrade gracefully under errors.

papers.title: Optimal Fair Aggregation of Crowdsourced Noisy Labels using Demographic Parity Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper bounds fairness gaps in crowdsourced label aggregation and provides discrete post-processing that enforces demographic parity.

papers.title: Optimal Transport under Group Fairness Constraints
papers.tldr: The paper develops exact and relaxed optimal transport methods for meeting group matching targets while examining their cost to matching quality.

papers.title: Position: Spatial Fairness: Foundations, Pitfalls, and a Path Forward
